title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Are you a DevOps Engineer who thrives on building scalable systems and solving complex infrastructure challenges? Ready to make an impact in a fast-growing, innovative technology environment? If so, we're looking for you!

About the Company:

Our client is shaping the future of business communications with groundbreaking solutions around messaging, voice, and AI. They’re dedicated to fostering a positive, supportive environment where employees thrive. Join a team where your impact is seen, valued, and celebrated.

Our client recently received the “Future of Work – Employee Experience Achievement” award by a prestigious communications media outlet.

About the Role:

As a DevOps Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure that powers our client’s high-availability voice and messaging platform.

This position bridges software engineering and systems engineering, ensuring reliable deployments, strong infrastructure performance, and operational excellence. You will collaborate closely with software developers, network engineers, and security teams to enhance automation, scalability, observability, and system resilience.

What You’ll Do:


 * Build and Maintain Infrastructure: Design, implement, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure supporting mission-critical communication services
 * Optimize Deployment Pipelines: Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable rapid, reliable software deployments
 * Automate Infrastructure: Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation to streamline provisioning and configuration
 * Monitor & Improve Reliability: Use observability platforms to monitor system performance, availability, and reliability
 * Strengthen System Resilience: Improve redundancy, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery strategies across infrastructure
 * Manage Containerized Environments: Support containerized applications and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes
 * Implement Security Best Practices: Ensure infrastructure and deployment pipelines follow modern security standards
 * Design & Optimize Network Infrastructure: Lead network architecture design and troubleshooting across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring low-latency, high-availability connectivity for real-time communication platforms
 * Troubleshoot & Support Operations: Diagnose production issues and participate in incident response to maintain platform stability
 * Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with engineering, networking, and security teams to support platform performance and scalability
   
   

About You:


 * 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Infrastructure Engineering roles, with a strong foundation in modern cloud environments
 * Hands-on experience with GCP (preferred) or other major cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
 * Proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or CloudFormation to design and manage scalable environments
 * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient, automated software deployments
 * Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar languages to automate processes and streamline operations
 * Practical experience with Docker and Kubernetes or other container orchestration technologies
 * Solid understanding of Linux systems administration and networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, and load balancing
 * A natural problem-solver who enjoys troubleshooting complex infrastructure challenges and optimizing system performance
 * Collaborative and effective working across engineering, networking, and operations teams
 * Experience in telecom, VoIP, or real-time communications platforms a plus
 * Exposure to SIP infrastructure, high-availability systems, or low-latency environments a plus
 * Cloud or security certifications (GCP certifications highly valued)
   
   

What’s In It for You?


 * Career Growth: Join a rapidly evolving company where your work directly impacts mission-critical communications infrastructure
 * Innovative Technology: Work on a platform that powers voice and messaging systems for enterprises across North America
 * Meaningful Impact: Help build and maintain systems that support reliable, large-scale communications services
 * Collaborative Engineering Environment: Work alongside experienced engineers focused on innovation, automation, and reliability
   
   

Benefits & Perks:


 * Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical (employee covered 100%), dental, and vision plans to keep you and your family healthy
 * Health and fitness programs: Access to wellness initiatives, fitness programs, and resources designed to support your physical and mental well-being
 * Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and refuel with PTO and 10+ paid company holidays
 * Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with 4% company match to help you plan for the future
 * Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary with performance incentives
 * Fun & Engaging Culture: Team-building events, company-wide volunteer days and a collaborative work environment
   
   

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about DevOps, automation, and building resilient cloud infrastructure, we want to hear from you. Apply today and help power the next generation of mission-critical communications technology.

 * Experience in high-growth tech or private equity-backed environments.
 * A background in transitioning monolithic build systems to microservices-based

 * Within 6 Months (Integration and Audit): You will have audited our primary legacy pipelines and identified the top three bottlenecks. You'll become a trusted partner by delivering your first automated "Golden Path" for a specific service, reducing manual intervention by at least 30%.

You will be the architect of a delivery system that allows Panopto engineers to focus entirely on innovation rather than troubleshooting the build.
